newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: VW Slovak unit revises up 97 output fcast.
newsitem.headline: VW Slovak unit revises up 97 output fcast.

text.p: Volkswagen Bratislava s.r.o., the Slovak unit of German car maker Volkswagen AG, has revised its 1997 output forecast to 34,000 cars, from an original estimate of 29,000, a company spokeswoman said.
"The original plan has been adjusted to 34,000 cars in 1997, based on the impressive production results over the first four months of the year," Maria Kovacikova told Reuters on Tuesday.
